# task-6db1dc74: recolor connected zero components

For this task family, identify the 4-connected components of color 0. Recolor every cell in every component of size greater than one to color 8. Leave singleton (isolated under orthogonal adjacency) zero cells as 0, and preserve all 1 cells. Diagonal contact alone does not connect zero cells.

## Evidence and validation

The 13x13 demonstration transformed clustered zero regions into 8 while preserving isolated zeros and all 1s. The rule also exactly solved a separate 13x13 test: find orthogonal zero-components, recolor components of size >=2, preserve singletons. Do not treat all zeros as noise or use diagonal connectivity.

## Procedure

1. Copy the input grid.
2. Flood-fill all color-0 cells with four-neighbor adjacency (up/down/left/right), recording component coordinates.
3. For each component with at least two cells, set its coordinates to 8.
4. Leave size-1 components at 0.
5. Validate dimensions and ensure 1-valued cells were untouched.",
